title: Ingestion backpressure + scope-aware trace sampling to preserve multi-tenant SLO fidelity
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: During bursts we drop large percentages of spans indiscriminately which erodes SLO signal for small tenants and skews burn-rate alerts. We need an ingestion/backpressure strategy that: 1) protects per-tenant SLO fidelity by preserving a scope-aware subset of spans and metrics, 2) controls cost by adaptive downsampling of low-value traces, and 3) surfaces backpressure indicators to the routing/runtime layer so downstream serving can adjust behavior.

Goal: Implement scope-aware trace sampling tied to tenant impact scores and an ingestion backpressure signal into the observability pipeline. Deliverables: sampling hints SDK hook, ingestion-side tenant-weighted reservoir sampler, metric normalization stage, and dashboards showing preserved SLI accuracy vs cost trade-off.
acceptance_criteria: SDK: trace client emits sampling_hint with tenant_id and span_scope for >99% of sampled spans
Ingestion: under simulated 5x burst, preserved SLI error for P95 latency SLI degrades <5% for tenants with <0.5% global traffic share
Backpressure: ingest pipeline emits 'observability.backpressure' metric and header propagated to router within 200ms
Cost: tokenized storage spend for traces reduced >=40% during sustained bursts compared to current all-pass baseline
Dashboards: new tenant-preservation dashboard and per-tenant preserved/span_rate panels are live and linked in ticket
comments: 2026-03-02 — Asha: Initial spike replay on prod-shadow shows 72% span loss for small tenants; created design doc in Confluence (link below).
2026-03-03 — Miguel: Prototype SDK hook (sampling_hint proto) landed in branch feature/tenant-sampling; needs tests for span_scope enum coverage. See PR #1428.

2026-03-05 — Design review (Eng + PM + Observability): decided to use a two-stage sampler — fast tenant-weighted reservoir at ingestion + periodic reservoir compaction to favor error/latency-weighted spans. Trade-offs: slightly higher CPU in ingestion (estimated +6%) vs much better SLI fidelity for small tenants.

2026-03-06 — Infra: confirmed the ingestion autoscaler can handle additional CPU when compaction runs every 10s; suggested backoff window when compaction overlaps with GC. Added mitigation note to runbook.
2026-03-08 — Miguel: Added backpressure metric emission and router header propagation. Integration test failing intermittently due to race in header propagation; investigating with networking team.
2026-03-10 — PM (Lena Brooks): thumbs-up on acceptance criteria; requested an A/B evaluation across 20% of traffic to quantify alerting behavior before full rollout.
notes: Work intentionally conservative on sampling decisions for regulated tenants. If tenant has data-retention_enforced label, we bypass sampling and retain full spans. Need legal confirmation for PII handling in sampling hints.
